notes: Making outfits is the activity and nothing is owned or built, so this is Roleplay & Avatar Sim on settlement-static — a fixed beach strip of shops where personalization runs through the avatar — but the NPC request, the ticket reward and the venue it unlocks are a genuine quest chain, so Adventure is named as secondary and contributes gate-progression for the ticket-locked fashion show door. I kept Morph Roleplay rather than Adventure's Quest Hub because there is no quest board and no fast travel, just a girl on a chair, who lands on npc-population as the named figure players come to see. The fashion show is one venue among the shops rather than the whole map, which is why stage-runway is not the shape here. Shops you make an outfit in are entered, so building-interior and its P3 are earned by a stated feature; I left the sea as backdrop and map edge rather than emitting water-body, since nobody swims and that would import a CHECK the prompt never asked for.
